protocol: PHASE_A_INFERENCE: read VAL808 images only; produce per-sample predictions (binary mask + probability map) for both the global reference and the final A8 system; write prediction artifact and hash it. GT masks are NOT read.
HASH_BARRIER: hash and freeze the prediction artifact BEFORE any GT access.
PHASE_B_SCORING: read VAL808 GT masks; compute Dice(global) and Dice(final_A8) per sample; compute deltas and the macro-domain estimand.
